import cv2, numpy as np

img4 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0004.png')
# Find where the vertical edge or wall corner is in obs_0004
# Look at row 200 across all columns:
diffs = []
for c in range(1, 511):
    diffs.append((abs(img4[200, c].astype(int) - img4[200, c-1].astype(int)).sum(), c))
diffs.sort(reverse=True)
print('Top diffs at row 200:', diffs[:10])

# Also check row 350
diffs350 = []
for c in range(1, 511):
    diffs350.append((abs(img4[350, c].astype(int) - img4[350, c-1].astype(int)).sum(), c))
diffs350.sort(reverse=True)
print('Top diffs at row 350:', diffs350[:10])
"
